confirmed.violation: Rule 460 states a Combat occurs when a Cleanup occurs, no items are on the Chain, a Combat is Staged at a Battlefield, and no Showdown/Combat is ongoing elsewhere — i.e. combat initiation is mandatory at Cleanup, not player-elective. The engine instead let the turn player take unrelated Neutral-Open actions while a Combat was Staged, offering `startShowdown` as merely one option among many.
